heading: What Is Poor Mental Health Costing Your Business?
intro: Poor mental health costs UK employers around £51 billion a year — through sickness absence, people working while unwell, and staff leaving. Enter the size of your workforce to see an estimate for your organisation.
shareDescription: Poor mental health costs UK employers £51 billion a year. Find out what it could be costing your business in seconds.
staffLabel: How many people does your organisation employ?
resultLabel: Poor mental health could be costing your organisation around
sourceNote: This is an estimate based on UK averages, not a measurement of your organisation. Figures are drawn from Deloitte's 2024 report "Mental health and employers", which puts the annual cost at £51bn (£24bn presenteeism, £20bn staff turnover and £7bn absence), spread across roughly 30 million UK employees.
ctaHeading: The good news: it can be reduced
ctaText: Deloitte found that employers get back an average of £4.70 for every £1 they invest in supporting their people's mental health. Training managers to spot the signs early and support their teams is one of the most effective places to start.
